build_info.bazel_module:
module(name = "rust_llm_wiki", version = "0.1.2")

bazel_dep(name = "platforms", version = "1.1.0")
bazel_dep(name = "rules_rust", version = "0.72.0")

rust = use_extension("@rules_rust//rust:extensions.bzl", "rust")
rust.toolchain(
    edition = "2024",
    versions = ["1.98.0"],
    extra_target_triples = [
        "aarch64-apple-darwin",
        "x86_64-apple-darwin",
        "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "aarch64-pc-windows-msvc",
        "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc",
    ],
)
use_repo(rust, "rust_toolchains")
register_toolchains("@rust_toolchains//:all")

crate = use_extension("@rules_rust//crate_universe:extensions.bzl", "crate")
crate.from_cargo(
    name = "crates",
    cargo_lockfile = "//:Cargo.lock",
    lockfile = "//:cargo-bazel-lock.json",
    manifests = ["//:Cargo.toml"],
    isolated = True,
    supported_platform_triples = [
        "aarch64-apple-darwin",
        "x86_64-apple-darwin",
        "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "aarch64-pc-windows-msvc",
        "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc",
    ],
)
crate.annotation(
    crate = "ring",
    version = "0.17.14",
    repositories = ["crates"],
    patches = ["//bazel:ring_windows_arm64_cflags.patch"],
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
)
crate.annotation_select(
    crate = "ring",
    version = "0.17.14",
    repositories = ["crates"],
    triples = ["aarch64-pc-windows-msvc"],
    build_script_env = {"LWIKI_RING_WINDOWS_ARM64_CLANG": "1"},
)
use_repo(crate, "crates")
